marks.gloss_en: עשבים מאן דכר שמייהו? -- the baraita said nothing of grass; how does R' Yehuda come to speak of it?
חסורי מיחסרא והכי קתני: ומכבדין אותן ומרביצין אותן כדי שלא יעלו בהן עשבים -- the baraita had a clause about grass, to which R' Yehuda's אימתי responds (= p_mechabdin_umarbitzin)
the baraita is lacking and teaches thus: and they sweep them and sprinkle them, so that grass does not grow in them
מלינין סלקא דעתך? לא סגי דלאו הכי? -- can it enter your mind that they lodge the dead there? is there no other way?
אלא, לסוף שילינו בו מת מצוה -- rather: in the end they will lodge a met mitzva there (= p_sofo_met_mitzva; an explication, not a refutation -- header)
Rav Asi: a synagogue in which calculations are calculated -- they lodge the dead in it overnight
and one does not adorn oneself in them
R' Yehuda: when [does this apply]? when they are inhabited
Rav Asi: the synagogues of Babylonia are made on condition
דאמר רבי יהושע בן לוי: מאי בי רבנן -- ביתא דרבנן: the Sages' place is their house, so they are permitted there
Rava: Sages and their students are permitted [to adorn themselves there]
כי הא דרבינא ורב אדא בר מתנה -- caught in the rain, they entered the synagogue only after declaring it was not because of the rain but for the clarity the halakha needs: the rule observed
Ravina and Rav Adda bar Matana were standing and asking a question of Rava; a shower of rain came; they entered the synagogue
what are the circumstances of a eulogy of the many?
Rafram eulogized his daughter-in-law in the synagogue
Reish Lakish eulogized a young scholar, found in the Land of Israel, who studied halakha in the twenty-fourth row
Rav Nachman, asked to eulogize one who had studied halakha, Sifra, Sifrei and Tosefta: how shall I eulogize him -- 'alas, a basket full of books is lost'?!
come and see the difference between the harsh ones of the Land of Israel and the pious ones of Babylonia
the mishna (Avot): and one who makes use of the crown perishes
Ulla: a man may make use of one who studies four [orders]
the man: it pleases me to serve the master
whoever studies halakhot is assured that he is of the world to come
Rav Acha son of Rava to Rav Ashi: if a person needs to call a man from the synagogue, what [is the law]?
